quote: is the god of the sky and thunder, and king of the gods.

statement.id: Jupiter adalah dewa langit dan guntur serta pemimpin para dewa.
statement.en: Jupiter is god of the sky and thunder and king of the gods.

quote: Jupiter was the chief deity of Roman state religion throughout the Republican and Imperial eras

statement.id: Jupiter adalah dewa utama agama negara Romawi pada zaman republik dan kekaisaran.
statement.en: Jupiter was the leading deity of Roman state religion in the Republican and Imperial eras.

quote: His identifying implement is the thunderbolt and his primary sacred animal is the eagle

statement.id: Petir dan elang merupakan lambang Jupiter.
statement.en: The thunderbolt and eagle are Jupiter's emblems.

quote: The Romans regarded Jupiter as the equivalent of the Greek Zeus

statement.id: Orang Romawi memandang Jupiter sebagai padanan Zeus Yunani.
statement.en: Romans viewed Jupiter as a counterpart of Greek Zeus.

quote: Jupiter's most important title was Jupiter Optimus Maximus, meaning the Best and Greatest and signifying his role as father of the gods.

statement.id: Gelar Jupiter Optimus Maximus menyatakan kedudukan Jupiter sebagai dewa tertinggi.
statement.en: The title Jupiter Optimus Maximus expressed Jupiter's supreme status.

quote: He protected Rome in time of war and maintained the welfare of the people during peace.

statement.id: Jupiter dipercaya melindungi Roma dalam perang dan menjaga kesejahteraan saat damai.
statement.en: Jupiter was held to protect Rome in war and preserve welfare in peace.

quote: He was most often portrayed with a long, white beard, and his symbol was the eagle atop a scepter

statement.id: Jupiter digambarkan berjanggut putih dan memiliki lambang elang pada tongkat.
statement.en: Jupiter is depicted with a white beard and an eagle on his scepter.

quote: The Romans considered the revered North African oracle Ammon an embodiment of Jupiter, and referred to this syncretic dual divinity as Jupiter Ammon.

statement.id: Ammon dari Afrika Utara disamakan dengan Jupiter sebagai Jupiter Ammon.
statement.en: North African Ammon was equated with Jupiter as Jupiter Ammon.

quote: Among the many gods of the Romans, Jupiter, the son of Saturn, was the supreme god, associated with thunder, lightning, and storms.

statement.id: Di antara banyak dewa Romawi, Jupiter, putra Saturnus, adalah dewa tertinggi yang dikaitkan dengan guntur, kilat, dan badai.
statement.en: Among the many Roman gods, Jupiter, son of Saturn, was the supreme god, associated with thunder, lightning, and storms.

quote: These new gods included Mars, the god of war; Quirinus, the deified Romulus who watched over the people of Rome; and lastly, Jupiter, the supreme god.

statement.id: Para dewa baru yang ditambahkan oleh warga awal Roma itu adalah Mars, Quirinus, dan Jupiter sebagai dewa tertinggi.
statement.en: The early citizens of Rome added a triad of gods consisting of Mars, Quirinus, and Jupiter as the supreme god.

quote: By the rise of the Republic, Jupiter's identity as the greatest of all the gods was firmly established, but two members of the old triad were replaced with Juno (his sister and wife) and Minerva (his daughter).

statement.id: Pada masa Republik, Jupiter mantap sebagai dewa terbesar, dan dua anggota triad lama diganti dengan Juno (saudari sekaligus istrinya) dan Minerva (putrinya).
statement.en: By the Republic, Jupiter was firmly established as the greatest god, and two members of the old triad were replaced by Juno (his sister and wife) and Minerva (his daughter).

quote: He was a god of light, a protector during defeat, and the giver of victory. He was Jupiter Imperator, the supreme general; Jupiter Invictus, the unconquered; and lastly, Jupiter Triumphator.

statement.id: Jupiter dipandang sebagai dewa cahaya, pelindung saat kekalahan, dan pemberi kemenangan, dengan gelar Imperator, Invictus, dan Triumphator.
statement.en: Jupiter was seen as a god of light, protector in defeat, and giver of victory, with the titles Imperator, Invictus, and Triumphator.

quote: As with Zeus, his reputation for violence often caused men to tremble in fear for he could easily punish them with one of his thunderbolts. Of course, he would give them a fair warning before the final, destructive bolt, and punishment was usually carried out only with the consent of the other gods.

statement.id: Jupiter dikenal keras: ia dapat menghukum manusia dengan petirnya, tetapi lebih dulu memberi peringatan, dan hukuman biasanya dijatuhkan dengan persetujuan dewa-dewa lain.
statement.en: Jupiter had a reputation for violence: he could punish people with a thunderbolt, but gave a warning first, and punishment was usually carried out with the consent of the other gods.

quote: Around 509 BCE a magnificent temple, shared with Juno and Minerva, was erected on Capitoline Hill in Rome, a place where people could gather and make sacrifices. Aside from a large sculpture of Jupiter, the temple, the grandest of all in Rome, housed the Sibylline books

statement.id: Sekitar 509 SM sebuah kuil megah yang dipakai bersama Juno dan Minerva didirikan di Bukit Capitolium di Roma; kuil itu menyimpan arca besar Jupiter dan kitab-kitab Sibylla.
statement.en: Around 509 BCE a magnificent temple shared with Juno and Minerva was built on Capitoline Hill in Rome; it housed a large sculpture of Jupiter and the Sibylline books.

quote: After returning from battle, victorious generals would lead a procession called a triumph through the streets of Rome to Jupiter's temple. ... After arriving at the temple, he would make a sacrifice, being sure to donate a portion of his booty to Jupiter, thanking Jupiter for his victory in battle.

statement.id: Jenderal yang menang berbaris dalam perarakan triumf menuju kuil Jupiter, lalu berkurban dan menyerahkan sebagian rampasan kepada Jupiter sebagai tanda terima kasih atas kemenangan.
statement.en: Victorious generals led a triumph procession to Jupiter's temple, made a sacrifice, and donated part of their booty to Jupiter in thanks for victory.

quote: The Senate would not allow a declaration of war without the blessing of Jupiter. He was the patron of oaths and treaties and the punisher of perjurers.

statement.id: Senat tidak mengizinkan pernyataan perang tanpa restu Jupiter, dan ia menjadi pelindung sumpah serta perjanjian sekaligus penghukum pemberi sumpah palsu.
statement.en: The Senate would not permit a declaration of war without Jupiter's blessing, and he was patron of oaths and treaties and punisher of perjurers.

quote: No political action was begun or completed without his judgment. The chief games celebrated in September, the Ludi Romani, were observed in his honor.

statement.id: Menurut sumber ini, tak ada tindakan politik yang dimulai atau diselesaikan tanpa pertimbangannya, dan Ludi Romani yang dirayakan pada bulan September diadakan untuk menghormatinya.
statement.en: No political action was begun or completed without his judgment, and the Ludi Romani, the chief games held in September, honored him.

quote: Emperor Elagabalus temporarily replaced Jupiter with Elagabal, a Syrian god.

statement.id: Kaisar Elagabalus untuk sementara menggantikan Jupiter dengan Elagabal, dewa Siria.
statement.en: Emperor Elagabalus temporarily replaced Jupiter with Elagabal, a Syrian god.

quote: In the Capitoline Triad, he was the central guardian of the state with Juno and Minerva. His sacred tree was the oak.

statement.id: Dalam Triad Capitolium ia menjadi pelindung utama negara bersama Juno dan Minerva; pohon sucinya adalah pohon ek.
statement.en: In the Capitoline Triad he was the central guardian of the state with Juno and Minerva; his sacred tree was the oak.

quote: In the Greek-influenced tradition, Jupiter was the brother of Neptune and Pluto, the Roman equivalents of Poseidon and Hades respectively. Each presided over one of the three realms of the universe: sky, the waters, and the underworld.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi yang dipengaruhi Yunani, Jupiter adalah saudara Neptunus dan Pluto; masing-masing menguasai satu dari tiga ranah alam semesta: langit, perairan, dan dunia bawah.
statement.en: In the Greek-influenced tradition Jupiter was brother of Neptune and Pluto, each presiding over one of the three realms of the universe: sky, waters, and underworld.

quote: Iūpiter or Iuppiter, from Proto-Italic *djous "day, sky" + *patēr "father", thus "sky father"

statement.id: Nama Latin Iūpiter atau Iuppiter berasal dari bentuk Proto-Italik *djous "hari, langit" ditambah *patēr "bapak", sehingga berarti "bapak langit".
statement.en: The Latin name Iūpiter or Iuppiter derives from Proto-Italic *djous "day, sky" plus *patēr "father", thus "sky father".

quote: Jove is a less common English formation based on Iov-, the stem of oblique cases of the Latin name.

statement.id: Jove adalah bentuk bahasa Inggris yang lebih jarang, dibentuk dari Iov-, pangkal kasus oblik nama Latinnya.
statement.en: Jove is a less common English formation based on Iov-, the stem of the oblique cases of the Latin name.

quote: Jupiter assumed atmospheric qualities; he is the wielder of lightning and the master of weather.

statement.id: Jupiter bersifat atmosferik: ia pemegang kilat dan penguasa cuaca.
statement.en: Jupiter took on atmospheric qualities: he is the wielder of lightning and master of weather.

quote: he is in continual communication with man by means of thunder, lightning and the flight of birds (his auspices). Through his vigilant watch, he is also the guardian of public oaths and compacts and the guarantor of good faith in the State cult.

statement.id: Jupiter terus berkomunikasi dengan manusia melalui guntur, kilat, dan terbang burung (auspisia-nya), serta menjaga sumpah dan perjanjian publik dan menjamin itikad baik dalam kultus negara.
statement.en: Jupiter communicates with people through thunder, lightning, and the flight of birds (his auspices), and guards public oaths and compacts and guarantees good faith in the state cult.

quote: Wissowa considered Jupiter also a god of war and agriculture, in addition to his political role as guarantor of good faith

statement.id: Wissowa menganggap Jupiter juga dewa perang dan pertanian, di samping perannya sebagai penjamin itikad baik.
statement.en: Wissowa considered Jupiter also a god of war and agriculture, besides his political role as guarantor of good faith.

quote: Dumézil maintains that Jupiter is not himself a god of war and agriculture, although his actions and interests may extend to these spheres of human endeavour.

statement.id: Dumézil berpendapat Jupiter sendiri bukan dewa perang dan pertanian, meski tindakan dan kepentingannya dapat menjangkau bidang-bidang itu.
statement.en: Dumézil maintains that Jupiter is not himself a god of war and agriculture, although his actions and interests may extend to those spheres.

quote: The Romans believed that Jupiter granted them supremacy because they had honoured him more than any other people had.

statement.id: Orang Romawi percaya Jupiter memberi mereka supremasi karena mereka menghormatinya lebih daripada bangsa lain.
statement.en: The Romans believed Jupiter granted them supremacy because they had honoured him more than any other people had.

quote: The consuls swore their oath of office in Jupiter's name, and honoured him on the annual feriae of the Capitol in September. To thank him for his help, and to secure his continued support, they sacrificed a white ox (bos mas) with gilded horns.

statement.id: Para konsul bersumpah jabatan atas nama Jupiter dan menghormatinya pada feriae tahunan Capitolium di bulan September, dengan mengurbankan seekor lembu putih bertanduk sepuh.
statement.en: The consuls swore their oath of office in Jupiter's name and honoured him at the annual feriae of the Capitol in September, sacrificing a white ox with gilded horns.

quote: Jove was the original namesake of Latin forms of the weekday now known in English as Thursday (originally called Iovis Dies in Latin).

statement.id: Jove adalah asal nama bentuk-bentuk Latin untuk hari yang dalam bahasa Inggris kini disebut Thursday (semula Iovis Dies dalam bahasa Latin).
statement.en: Jove was the original namesake of the Latin forms of the weekday now called Thursday in English (originally Iovis Dies in Latin).

quote: Tinia is usually regarded as his Etruscan counterpart.

statement.id: Tinia umumnya dianggap sebagai padanan Jupiter dalam tradisi Etruscan.
statement.en: Tinia is usually regarded as his Etruscan counterpart.

quote: In Roman mythology, he negotiates with Numa Pompilius, the second king of Rome, to establish principles of Roman religion such as offering, or sacrifice.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Romawi, Jupiter berunding dengan Numa Pompilius, raja kedua Roma, untuk menetapkan asas agama Romawi seperti persembahan atau kurban.
statement.en: In Roman mythology he negotiates with Numa Pompilius, the second king of Rome, to establish principles of Roman religion such as offering or sacrifice.

quote: found there a description of certain secret sacrificial rites paid to Jupiter Elicius ... the anger of Jupiter was roused by the false worship rendered to him, and he burnt up the king and his house by a stroke of lightning. Tullus had achieved great renown in war

statement.id: Menurut Livius, Tullus Hostilius menemukan tata cara rahasia untuk Jupiter Elicius, tetapi ia keliru melaksanakannya; Jupiter murka dan membakar sang raja beserta rumahnya dengan sambaran petir.
statement.en: According to Livy, Tullus found secret rites for Jupiter Elicius but performed them wrongly; Jupiter was angered and burnt up the king and his house with a stroke of lightning.

quote: Even Romulus was being swept away by the crowd of fugitives, and lifting up his hands to heaven he exclaimed: ‘Jupiter, it was thy omen ... Here do I vow a temple to thee, ‘Jove the Stayer,’ as a memorial for the generations to come that it is through thy present help that the City has been saved.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Livius, Romulus berjanji mendirikan kuil bagi "Jove sang Penahan" (Jupiter Stator) sebagai pengingat bahwa kota itu selamat berkat pertolongan Jupiter.
statement.en: In Livy's account Romulus vows a temple to "Jove the Stayer" (Jupiter Stator) as a memorial that the City was saved through Jupiter's help.

quote: Then, as though he had become aware that his prayer had been heard, he cried, ‘Back, Romans! Jupiter Optimus Maximus bids you stand and renew the battle.

statement.id: Romulus lalu berseru kepada orang Romawi bahwa Jupiter Optimus Maximus memerintahkan mereka bertahan dan melanjutkan pertempuran.
statement.en: Romulus then cries out that Jupiter Optimus Maximus bids the Romans stand and renew the battle.

quote: after leading his victorious army home, he mounted to the Capitol with the spoils of his dead foe borne before him on a frame constructed for the purpose. He hung them there on an oak, which the shepherds looked upon as a sacred tree, and at the same time marked out the site for the temple of Jupiter

statement.id: Dalam kisah Livius, setelah membawa pasukannya pulang dengan kemenangan, sang pemimpin mendaki Capitolium membawa rampasan dari musuh yang gugur, menggantungnya pada pohon ek yang dianggap suci oleh para gembala, dan menandai lahan kuil Jupiter.
statement.en: In Livy's account, after leading his victorious army home, the leader mounted to the Capitol with the spoils of his dead foe, hung them on an oak the shepherds held sacred, and marked out the site for Jupiter's temple.

quote: addressing the god by a new title, uttered the following invocation: ‘Jupiter Feretrius! ... these arms taken from a king, I, Romulus a king and conqueror, bring to thee, and on this domain, whose bounds I have in will and purpose traced, I dedicate a temple to receive the spolia opima

statement.id: Dalam kisah Livius, Romulus menyapa sang dewa dengan gelar baru, Jupiter Feretrius, mempersembahkan senjata seorang raja musuh, dan menguduskan sebuah kuil untuk menerima spolia opima.
statement.en: In Livy's account Romulus addresses the god by a new title, Jupiter Feretrius, offers the arms taken from a king, and dedicates a temple to receive the spolia opima.

quote: Jove once again broke the deep silence with imperial words; ... this Lycaon mocked their pious vows ... I destroyed his dwelling and his worthless Household Gods, with thunder bolts avenging.

statement.id: Dalam Metamorphoses karya Ovidius, Jupiter menghancurkan kediaman Lycaon dengan petir sebagai pembalasan.
statement.en: In Ovid's Metamorphoses Jupiter destroys Lycaon's dwelling with thunderbolts as vengeance.
